name: 45230 · Cincinnati, OH
findings: ZIP 45230 (Cincinnati) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45230 (Cincinnati) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
